Instrument of Human Resource Sub-Delegation
COVID-19 Pandemic Event - Paid Special Pandemic Leave
The Director-General, Department of Health has administratively applied by way of Memoranda paid Special
Pandemic Leave under the Minister for Industrial Relations and Commission Chief Executive Directive 01/20:
Employment Arrangements in the Event of a Health Pandemic and paid discretionary Special Leave under
Minister for Employment and Industrial Relations Directive 05/17: Special Leave to health service employees
employed under the Hospital and Health Boards Act 2011 during the declared pandemic event. Further the
Director-General has authorised Health Service Chief Executives to sub-delegatethe authority to approve or
not approve these leave types. These Directives provide leave entitlements beyond those provided in relevant
industrial Awards and Certified Agreements.
Therefore, I, Noelle Cridland, Health Service Chief Executive (HSCE), Metro South Hospital and Health Service,
in pursuance of Section 34, Division 3, Part 2 and Section 46%, Division 1, Part 3 of the Hospital and Health Boards
Act 2011, effective as at 5 December 2022:
(a) sub-delegate the power to approve/not approve paid Special Pandemic Leave in accordance with
Directives 05/17 and 01/20 respectively, for this pandemic event (COVID-19)only, toa Band 9 delegate.

This Instrument does not permit the further sub-delegation of the powers outlined in (a) above.
Approved by:
